extract_probe.label: english-g8-families
extract_probe.extract_md:
Families is a lesson that teaches family member vocabulary, adverbs of degree and manner, pronunciation of the letter i, and how to describe family members and family history.

## Concepts & terms
- aunt
- cousin
- grandchild
- granddaughter
- grandfather
- grandmother
- grandparent
- grandson
- nephew
- niece
- uncle
- Adverbs of manner
- Adverbs of degree
- Family tree

## Rules & theorems
- Adverbs of manner describe how we do things and are often formed by adding -ly to an adjective.
- For adjectives ending in -l, we double the l and add -y in the adverb form (e.g., beautifully).
- For adjectives ending in a consonant + -y, we remove the -y and add -ily (e.g., easily).
- Irregular adverbs of manner include good -> well, fast -> fast, hard -> hard.

## Worked-example types
- Complete a family tree using listening descriptions of family relationships.
- Describe family members and their characteristics using descriptive adjectives and adverbs.
- Rewrite adjectives into their correct adverb forms and use them in sentences.
- Read an article about growing up in a big family and answer reading comprehension questions.
- Write a description of your own family using appropriate vocabulary and grammar.

## Key facts
- The letter 'i' can make different sounds, such as /ɪ/ as in milk and /aɪ/ as in night.
- Adverbs of degree include words like certainly, nearly, probably, quite, and really.

extract_probe.extract_md:
Mazkur dars o‘zbek xalqining buyuk qahramonlik dostoni bo‘lgan “Alpomish” dostonining yaratilish tarixi, Fozil Yo‘ldosh o‘g‘li ijrosi, bosh qahramonlari, asarning g‘oyaviy-badiiy mazmuni va undagi ezgu insoniy fazilatlarni yoritadi.

## Concepts & terms
- O‘n olti urug‘ qo‘ng‘irot eli
- Elatiya
- Biy (bek)
- Ravza (maqbara)
- Shoyi (shoh)
- Chupronto‘y (sunnat to‘yi)
- Juz’ya
- Narmoda
- Kulaband
- Shabgir tortish
- Shobir
- Zinkiyib
- Dabgiridan adashib
- Shamiyon qaytarib
- Poyim

## Key facts
- “Alpomish” dostonining qirqdan ortiq nusxasi yozib olingan bo‘lib, ular orasida Fozil Yo‘ldosh o‘g‘li aytgan nusxa eng mukammali hisoblanadi.
- Fozil Yo‘ldosh o‘g‘li 1872-yilda Jizzax viloyatining Baxmal tumaniga qarashli Loyqa qishlog‘ida tug‘ilgan.
- 1999-yilda “Alpomish” dostonining yaratilganining ming yilligi mamlakatimizda keng bayram qilingan.
- Dobonbiydan Alpinbiy, Alpinbiydan Boybo‘ri va Boysari tug‘ilgan.
- Shohimardon pir Boybo‘rining o‘g‘lining otini Hakimdor (Alpomish), qizining otini Qaldirg‘ochoyim, Boysarining qizining otini Oybarchin deb qo‘yib, beshikterti qilgan.
- Alpomish yetti yoshida Alpinbiy bobosidan qolgan o‘n to‘rt botmon bronza yoyni tortib alp bo‘lgan.
- Boysari Boybo‘rining zakot talab qilishidan xafa bo‘lib, o‘n ming uyli qo‘ng‘irot eli bilan Qalmoq yurtiga (Kashal eliga) ko‘chib ketgan.
- Barchinoyning to‘rt sharti: poyga, yoy tortish, ming qadamdan tanga pulni urish va kurashda to‘qson alpni yiqish bo‘lgan.
- Alpomishning tulpor oti – Boychibor.
